items.name: Bjurböle
items.summary: Bjurböle is an officially recognized L/LL4 ordinary chondrite that fell in Uusimaa, Finland, in 1899; the Meteoritical Bulletin Database records 330 kg for the meteorite (code 5064).

items.name: Kaalijarv
items.summary: Kaalijarv is an officially recognized IAB-MG iron meteorite found in Estonia in 1937; the Meteoritical Bulletin Database records 2.25 kg for the meteorite (code 12217).

items.name: Aguas Zarcas
items.summary: Aguas Zarcas is an officially recognized CM2 carbonaceous chondrite that fell in Alajuela, Costa Rica, on April 23, 2019. The Meteoritical Bulletin reports that the first recovered stone broke through a house, a 280 g piece struck a doghouse, and hundreds of stones totaling about 27 kg were recovered, including approximately 11 kg collected before rain reached the fall site (code 69696).

items.name: Ksar Ghilane 022
items.summary: Ksar Ghilane 022 is an officially recognized ungrouped achondrite found in Tatawin, Tunisia, in 2023 and described in the Meteoritical Bulletin as an Mg-rich clinopyroxenite composed predominantly of augite (code 82150).
